articles.title: OpenAI Builds Pando Git Infrastructure Using AI Agents and Deploys Continuous Security Testing
articles.summary:

articles.title: North Korean Hackers Abuse Internal AI Tool and Fake Job Interviews in $6.34 Billion Binance Heist
articles.summary:
North Korean hackers used a fake job interview, a poisoned coding task, and a hijacked internal AI tool to reach Binance’s wallet systems. The FBI says the North Korean group it calls “TraderTraitor” stole more than $6 billion in digital assets on 29 October 2026. Binance puts the impacted value at about USD 6.34 billion. […]

articles.summary:

articles.title: Hackers Target Supermarket Refrigeration Systems Across Europe, Raising Freezer Temperatures to 50°C
articles.summary:

The attacks, reported on Monday, November 2, have raised concerns about the security of connected equipment across Europe’s food supply chain. articles.summary:

articles.title: Microsoft Reveals 78% of Exploited Vulnerabilities Enable System Takeover and Privilege Escalation
articles.summary:
Microsoft’s new research shows that attackers pick flaws that give them control of a system. About 78% of vulnerabilities exploited in real attacks let an attacker take over a system or raise their privileges. The finding comes from a data study published on November 2, 2026, by Microsoft Security Research. Software flaws keep piling up. […]
